dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D tapering from the widest mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical bulge on the right lateral margin relative to the more linear left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey skin tone with visible specular highlights along the right lateral edge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey mottling across the mid-dorsal region and surrounding the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between varying grey pixel intensities across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, thin linear streaks visible on the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scratches/rake marks on the dorsal surface.
